messages:
sara_sales: Hey team — customer on the POC (FinCorp) asked for concrete audit evidence for admin actions and SIEM ingest during the trial. They want: list of admin actions, sample exported logs, retention policy, and confirmation of immutability.

ben_security: Thanks. We can provide:
- Admin activity timeline (console/API) with user IDs and actions
- Example export (JSONL) covering 3 days
- Retention config (13 months default for enterprise)
- WORM/immutable object proof via S3 Object Lock + ledger

alejandro_eng: For the POC we can spin up a short export job. Quick rough command to pull logs from our internal audit API:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://audit.redwood.ai/v1/exports?start=2026-03-10&end=2026-03-13&ids=fin-corp-poc" \
  -o fincorp-audit-20260310-13.jsonl
```
Outputs are JSONL with fields: ts, actor, action, target, request_id, metadata.

julia_ops: We can also produce a signed manifest proving integrity (SHA256 for each file) and upload to a customer-accessible S3 bucket with Object Lock enabled. Example manifest line:
`sha256  d2c7...  fincorp-audit-20260310-13.jsonl`

sara_sales: Can we also provide a short walkthrough for Splunk/Elastic ingest? Customer runs Splunk Cloud.

alejandro_eng: Yep. For Splunk HEC we can forward in near real-time or provide batch exports. Example HEC forwarder config (rsyslog -> Splunk HEC):
```
module(load="omfwd")
action(type="omfwd" target="splunk-hec.example" port="8088" protocol="tcp" template="RSYSLOG_ForwardFormat")
```
Or they can pull the JSONL and index with Splunk's HTTP Event Collector using token.

ben_security: For the security questionnaire: note that logs include principal identifiers, IP, request payload hash, and policy decisions. We maintain TTL/retention policy as documented in our SIG pack. For enterprise we support custom retention via customer contract.

sara_sales: Customer also asked: will admin activity logs be tamper-evident? They want proof in an audit.

julia_ops: We provide two layers: S3 Object Lock (governance/mode) + per-file SHA256 signed by our key. We can include KMS CMKs (customer-managed) for encryption-at-rest. We can give a short statement they can use in their vendor risk review.

ben_security: I'll draft a one-page control narrative (who/what/how) and attach a sample export. After I post it, @sara_sales can share with FinCorp.

sec-bot: Deployment notice — export job fincorp-export-1798743210 started by alejandro_eng at 2026-03-20T15:22:40Z :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

alejandro_eng: Export finished. Upload link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-poc-exports/fincorp/fincorp-audit-20260310-13.jsonl (expires in 7 days).

sara_sales: Perfect. Ben, appreciate the control narrative. Can you include specific fields and a short sample (3 lines) from the export so the customer's security team can validate schema quickly?

ben_security: On it. Sample snippet:
```
{"ts":"2026-03-11T09:12:05Z","actor":"admin:user-alex","action":"update_model_config","target":"model:rw-v1","request_id":"req_01F3X...","ip":"54.12.33.44","result":"success"}
{"ts":"2026-03-11T09:13:01Z","actor":"system:autoscaler","action":"scale_up","target":"node:gpu-12","request_id":"req_01F3Y...","ip":"internal","result":"success"}
{"ts":"2026-03-12T20:45:22Z","actor":"admin:user-lee","action":"role_change","target":"user:user-kim","request_id":"req_01F4A...","ip":"18.203.12.7","result":"failure","failure_reason":"policy_violation"}
```

sara_sales: Great. I'll push to them and schedule a short call to walkthrough the export and retention options. :thumbsup:

ben_security: Also note: for legal/audit we can provide chain-of-custody: export job IDs, who requested, who approved, and S3 object versions. If they need signed attestations we can route through our compliance lead.

alejandro_eng: FYI — if FinCorp wants continuous SIEM feed for the POC, we can enable a TCP forwarder to their Splunk endpoint (HEC) for 48h window. PM me the endpoint and token and we'll enable test mode.

sara_sales: Will do. Thanks everyone :rocket:
